_about: Spoiler-free dramatis personae rendered as a front-matter page by build_reading_epub.py (render_cast). Each figure is described by the role in which the reader first meets them: surface identities only, no hidden allegiances, deaths, romances-as-reveals, or plot turns. Keep blurbs short. The novel's characters are the author's invention (see the translator's note).
lead: A guide to the principal figures, each described by the role in which the reader first meets them. All are the author's invention; their world is real.

groups.note: The secret action group in Shanghai and the Party leaders it answers to.

members.blurb: Sent from the Party's central leadership to take charge of the secret operation in Shanghai; the group's commander, and the story's center.
The seasoned head of the Shanghai action group, and the superior of most of its members.
A special commissioner from the Party centre, working the operation alongside Chen Qianli.
A woman cadre of the underground and a published writer; one of the group.
A quick-witted, streetwise member who works the city as a house-letting agent.
The younger brother of Chen Qianli, and a member of the group. (Note the near-identical names.)
A young woman of the group, a schoolteacher and the daughter of a famous chef; close to Chen Qianyuan.
A member who labors at the Maochang coal yard as his cover.
The group's physician, who keeps a clinic for a cover.
A Red Army commander recuperating in Shanghai who joins the underground work.
A member of the Shanghai group.
Keeps a painting-and-scroll shop and works within the Shanghai underground group.
The code name of a senior Party leader whom the operation must move safely out of Shanghai.

groups.note: The pursuers hunting the group for the Nanjing government.

members.blurb: The spymaster leading the hunt for the group; a senior officer of the party's secret service and a former professor. The chief adversary.
Captain of the detective squad and Ye Qinian's chief field man and enforcer.
A garrison judge advocate who cooperates with Ye Qinian's operation.

groups.note: Civilians and others who cross the characters' paths.

members.blurb: A celebrated Yangzhou chef, and Dong Huiwen's father.
A Shanghai socialite who drifts across the characters' paths.
